<function name="GetPersistent" parent="Entity" type="classfunc">
	<description>
Returns whether the entity is persistent or not.

See <page>Entity:SetPersistent</page> for more information on persistence.
	</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="boolean">True if the entity is set to be persistent.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
